status: Local Bluetooth preview validated; no release tag created
scope: Complete the existing Windows/Android Bluetooth onboarding flow using the existing RFCOMM transport and device authentication.

checks: Existing connection dialog explains Bluetooth without requiring USB
Denied Bluetooth permission shows a recoverable explanation
Permission grant automatically resumes the existing paired-device picker
Fresh app identity authenticates directly over Bluetooth without a USB Code Link connection
Desktop confirms the authenticated Bluetooth transport
Bluetooth input reaches the mapped Windows terminal
Existing More > Bluetooth reconnect reuses app trust without rescanning
Reconnect preserves control and each input is delivered once
Bluetooth invitation stays Bluetooth even when the dialog initially selects USB
Camera permission grant continues to the existing scanner
physicalChecks.scope: Dedicated fresh app identity on the physical tablet, existing Windows RFCOMM host. USB is used for test automation; Code Link traffic for this identity is Bluetooth. Invitation paste and scanner permission continuation tested; optical QR capture not exercised.
